verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's privacy docs say customers can have personal data processed and stored in Europe through its EU Data Residency Program, so there is a real residency choice. The evidence is a single brief line, and Europe is the only alternative region it documents. missing for 10: regions other than the EU, how a region is selected at project setup, migration between regions, which data types and processing are covered (e.g. session replay, MCP and AI features), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
